name: Judges
title: Judges — Every Man His Own Way
tagline: When there is no king, sin cycles deepen.

author.traditional: Anonymous; often linked to prophetic historiography (Samuel circle).

date.range_display: Period between Joshua and monarchy; written looking back toward kingship need.

audience: Israel needing to see the failure of autonomy.
purpose: Expose the spiral of apostasy and the need for righteous rule.
christ: The true King Israel lacked; judges save temporarily — He saves finally.
spirit: Spirit rushes on judges for deliverance — power without lasting holiness still fails.
jesus_in_this_book: The true King Israel lacked; judges save temporarily — He saves finally.
how_to_read: Do not romanticize the judges. Feel the ache for a king.
watchman_charge: Reject “everyone did what was right in his own eyes.” Submit to the King.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
